Hi Sara —

Thanks again for your time today. Quick recap from our discovery: 
- Goal: reduce model inference latency for search + summarization flows by 3-4x while keeping quality parity
- Current constraints: 5-10M monthly inference tokens, sensitive customer PII, self-hosting considerations for Q1 2027
- Success metrics: p50 latency < 250ms for short queries, predictable per-token cost at scale

Next steps I proposed on the call: schedule a technical deep dive/demo with Aditya (solutions engineer) to validate our runtime fit and go over deployment options (Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private). Can you please confirm: 
1) Who from your side should attend the technical deep dive (engineers, infra, security)?
2) Which of these windows work for your team: Tue 2026-10-06 10:00-11:00 PT or Wed 2026-10-07 13:00-14:00 PT?

I can send a calendar invite with a Zoom link and a short agenda once you confirm attendees and preferred time. Also attaching a one-page product overview and a draft mutual action plan for reference (attached).

Best,
Marissa Cole

marissa.cole@redwood.com
